news.headline: Bengals cut WR Ke'Shawn Williams after costly muffed punt
news.detail: The Cincinnati Bengals cut WR Ke'Shawn Williams after he muffed a punt that eventually led to the Pittsburgh Steelers' 30-27 win. On Tuesday, Cincinnati signed WR Mitch Tinsley.
